safe_area.reason: The right rail carries the follow, like, comment and share controls and the lower band carries the handle and caption. A still used as a cover or an in-feed frame loses anything placed under either, and the right-hand loss is larger than on other social formats.

structural_rules.focal_requirement: One idea legible while the frame is in motion in a fast feed. Treat it as a cover, not a page: it earns the tap or it is gone.
